title: One source of a story project, fetched once and processed (data/stories/<id>/sources/<source>.json)
description: Hand-kept by the project's lead and the ontologist (board/the-story-projects.md). What the page is and says, read once: its facts go to claims.json (citing this id), the entities it names to entities.json. Public pages reachable without login only; nothing marked for internal use.

access.description: Reachable without login and not marked internal (anything else is not kept here).

what_it_says.description: In a few sentences, in English.

items.description: An entity of the graph (<type>:<id>), or local:<slug> for one this project names that the graph does not have yet.

links.description: The pages it links to that matter to the story.

status.description: For example: unchanged since a date, or 404 on a later read.
